sentences.text: This matter is taken up through hybrid arrangement (virtual/physical) mode.
2. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned Additional Standing Counsel.

3. Perused the averments taken in the writ petition as well as the documents annexed thereto.
4. It appears that the Petitioner by filing the writ petition seeks to execute the award dated 02.04.2024 passed by the learned Civil Judge (Senior Division), Nuapada in L.A.R. No.32 of 2019 in the matter of reference under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act,1894.

As provided under Sub-section (2) of Section 26 of the Land Acquisition Act,1894, which corresponds to Sub-section (2) of Section 28 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, the said award being a deemed decree is very much executable by the Cart passing the same as provided in the Code of Civil Procedure.

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
We, therefore,
dispose of this writ petition granting liberty to the Petitioner to approach the appropriate forum as provided under law seeking execution of the said award and realization of the awarded amount in accordance with law.
Issue urgent certified copy of this order as per rules

.
